description: Create the config file and the locale catalogs, and detect the bundler or meta-framework so the answer names the package to add and the line to wire (what `verbaly init` does). A file already there is kept, never overwritten, so running it again is safe. Use it when verbaly_doctor finds no config; once the project is set up, verbaly_doctor is the one to run.

root.description: Project root holding verbaly.config (defaults to the server working directory)

sourceLocale.description: The language you write in (default: en)

name: verbaly_init

created.description: Files written, relative to the project root

found.description: Catalogs the project already had, which the new config points at

host.description: Bundler or meta-framework detected from the dependencies

next.description: What a human still has to do, in order

refused.description: Locales left out: not a locale tag, and no sure way to fix one

renamed.description: Locales written with the hyphen a locale tag takes (pt_BR became pt-BR)

title: Set up Verbaly in a project
